_: Work covers as layers on a plain plate. x, y, w: % of the plate (screens may run off its edge); r: corner radius in % of the plate's width (0 keeps the screen's own corners); hx, hy: how far the layer drifts on hover, in % of its own size. Read by src/components/Work.astro and by scripts/make-layered-cover.mjs (which renders the flat cover the case study opens with).
